verdicts.reasoning: Bounded residual coverable by a screen, not a credible inadvertent fire. Geometry re-measured on the native board: QSPI_IO2 track (17.0,49.1)-(18.9,49.1) w0.2 is 0.550 mm from U1.3's inner pad end, mask-covered and under the U1 body; U1.1-U1.3 pad edges 0.700 mm with the analog-only no-net U1.2 between (0.200 mm webs), so only a three-lead bridge (or a mask void) joins QSPI_IO2 to PE4. The board's gate network is R127 1k to GND at PE4, R126 220R series, R128 10k and C126 220 nF gate-source (C128 is 100 nF on the drain, PYRO1_OUT); the reviewer's calculation omits C126. With the bridge a DC fight gives 1.19-1.98 V at the gate (MCU drivers) and fires the match after about 0.55 ms of continuous fight, but C126 makes the gate an RC average (tau 47-53 us): page-program logging at >= 25 MHz keeps the e-match RMS current <= 6 mA (>= 50x below the 0.30 A no-fire) at any page rate. Fire needs a sustained IO2-high fight (PE2 driven high as GPIO, long or parked memory-mapped quad reads with the flash at 100 % drive, or slow-clock <= 10 MHz quad page programs of IO2-dense data at high rates with a low-VGS(th) FET). The defect is AOI-visible (Inf) and corrupts quad QSPI bits 6/2 deterministically at the flash's default 25 % drive (fight level 0.57-0.84 V below the MCU VIL max 0.99 V), so the bench QSPI qualification would expose it with dummy loads, but no explicit documented gate does; the passive cold screen does not dependably see it. Intact board meets F7/F8; AGENTS 2.4 holds even with the bridge (reset: both pins analog, no pull-up on QSPI_IO2, R127/R128 hold the gate off). Single-bridge cases are an inventoried residual class (R10_VALIDATION section 1 lists this pair). Hence Minor: bounded residual plus a gate gap.

recommended_fix.summary: Make the screen explicit before an e-match meets the live bus. (1) ORDERING 8.3 first article, before coating and first power: inspect U1 pins 1-5 at >= 10x and meter U3.3 (QSPI_IO2) to R127.1 (PYRO1_GATE_N); require no beep / > 100 ohm (bridge ~0 ohm, intact diode-plus-1k or open; Inf). (2) Firmware ground refusal before PC1 enable, PC1/PE4 locked low: quad-mode read-verify of a known all-ones region at the default W25Q DRV, or a >= 1 ms PE2-high aggressor with the bus off refusing if CONT leaves band. (3) Firmware rules while PC1 is high: keep W25Q DRV at default, no parked memory-mapped mode without the QUADSPI timeout, no bulk quad reads, never drive PE2 high as GPIO, Quad Page Program only at >= 25 MHz (or use 0x02). (4) Add the mechanism and screen to the R10_VALIDATION section 1 row for this pair.

verdicts.reasoning: Bounded margin residual. The native ACT_GATE copper graph confirms via (16.200,73.300) 0.50/0.30 mm is the only link from R121.1 (F.Cu) to Q120.4/C120.2/R120.2 (B.Cu): opening it in memory splits the net into {R121.1, Q121.4, R119.1} and {Q120.4, C120.2, R120.2}; Q120 is then held off by R120 100k / C120 1 uF (VGS = 0) and, with PC1 high, the bus is fed through Q120's body diode and Q121. Opening the other via (11.14,71.7) kills the bus instead (fail-safe, refused by the powered check). Neither open creates a fire path. The parts_budget.json fire_current_GAP1 model reproduces exactly (branch 4.4678 ohm recomposed from its parts; 1.5409/1.4758/1.4104/1.3448/1.2787 A for 0-4 stalls); adding VSD 0.7 / 1.0 V gives 1.128 / 1.063 A at four stalls (1.137 / 1.072 A if Q120's 0.04 ohm channel is removed), 1.194 / 1.129 A at three, 1.390 / 1.325 A idle, matching the finding. That is 0.93-1.01x the project's 1.125 A floor but 1.39-1.52x the maker's 0.75 A all-fire and 1.04-1.14x the maker's 1.00 A recommended minimum firing current; a first-order bridgewire model bounded by the maker's no-fire / all-fire / 4 mJ figures fires the least sensitive admissible match in 4.1-5.2 ms (intact 3.0 ms), inside the 20 ms pulse (Inf). F7's floor is the intact-board budget, so a shortfall that needs a single via fault plus the conditional four-stall case is not a demonstrated failure of F7, and AGENTS section 2 is untouched. Detection is incomplete but available: probing ACT_GATE on Q120's side (R120.2 / C120.2, already in the ORDERING 8.3 probe worksheet) or recording the dummy-load fire drop catches a pre-existing open; the idle BUS reads 5.4-7.4 % low for a later one.

recommended_fix.summary: Now (text): ORDERING 8.3 first article - probe ACT_GATE at both R119.1 and R120.2 / C120.2 with PC1 high and record |VGS| for each FET; record BAT_IN - RAW_ACT (or the fire current) during the dummy-load fire, failing a drop above 0.2 V; adopt the powered BUS-vs-VLOGIC band per flight once qualified. Respin: a second F.Cu-B.Cu via at Q120's gate.
recommended_fix.respin_option: Second F.Cu-B.Cu via in parallel with (16.2,73.3) on Q120's gate net (next board change).

notes: The brief's 'C128 gate-source' is a mislabel: on 5516eeec the Q124 gate-source capacitor is C126 220 nF (PYRO1_GATE to GND); C128 100 nF sits on PYRO1_OUT (drain) to GND.

The R23-SAFETY-08(a) statement 'with the bus enabled that fires the match during QSPI logging' is overstated for page-program logging at >= 25 MHz; it holds for sustained IO2-high fights of >= about 0.55 ms.
